name: Flins
title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

passives.name: Symphony of Winter
passives.descriptionRaw:
Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.
passives.description:
Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.

passives.name: Whispering Flame
passives.descriptionRaw: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.
passives.description: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Old World Secrets
passives.descriptionRaw:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

combatTalents.name: Pocztowy Demonspear
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward spear throw.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

combatTalents.name: Ancient Rite: Arcane Light
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Flame</color> form. This form has the following characteristics:
· Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
· His interruption resistance is increased.
· His Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: Arcane Light</color> is replaced with the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and causing his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color> to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst {LINK#N11200001}<color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color>{/LINK} for the next 6s.
The base CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color> is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst **Thunderous Symphony** for the next 6s.
The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

combatTalents.name: Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional 2 instances of middle-phase Lunar-Charged <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>.

After using the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>, Flins's Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color> for the next 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color>
Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>.
combatTalents.description:
Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing AoE Electro DMG and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase AoE Electro DMG, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional 2 instances of middle-phase Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.

After using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, Flins's Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.

Thunderous Symphony
Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of AoE Electro DMG that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.

constellations.name: Part the Veil of Snow
constellations.descriptionRaw:
The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color> is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

constellations.name: The Devil's Wall
constellations.descriptionRaw:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: While Flins is on the field, after his <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> will be decreased by 25% for 7s.
